s1.syndrome_frame: bilateral breast lumps with suspicious masses and lymphadenopathy
salient_findings: left breast lump fixed to the chest wall
irregular spiculated mass in the left breast on MRI
key_facts: 48-year-old woman
type 2 diabetes
hypertension
bilateral breast lumps of one-week duration
no family history of breast or ovarian cancer
regular menstrual cycles
left breast lump 4 × 4 cm hard and fixed to the chest wall
right breast lump 1 × 1 cm firm and mobile
MRI showed irregular spiculated mass in the left breast
MRI showed well-defined lesion in the right breast
bilateral axillary lymphadenopathy on MRI
ultrasound and bone scan negative for metastases
fine-needle aspiration cytology of left breast lump showed malignant cells
FNAC of left axillary lymph node showed malignant cells
core-needle biopsy of left breast confirmed infiltrative duct cell carcinoma
estrogen- and progesterone-receptor positive

raw.syndrome_frame: bilateral breast lumps with suspicious masses and lymphadenopathy
salient_findings: left breast lump fixed to the chest wall
irregular spiculated mass in the left breast on MRI
key_facts: 48-year-old woman
type 2 diabetes
hypertension
bilateral breast lumps of one-week duration
no family history of breast or ovarian cancer
regular menstrual cycles
left breast lump 4 × 4 cm hard and fixed to the chest wall
right breast lump 1 × 1 cm firm and mobile
MRI showed irregular spiculated mass in the left breast
MRI showed well-defined lesion in the right breast
bilateral axillary lymphadenopathy on MRI
ultrasound and bone scan negative for metastases
fine-needle aspiration cytology of left breast lump showed malignant cells
FNAC of left axillary lymph node showed malignant cells
core-needle biopsy of left breast confirmed infiltrative duct cell carcinoma
estrogen- and progesterone-receptor positive

shortlist.label: invasive ductal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: confirmed by core-needle biopsy of left breast

shortlist.label: medullary carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: poorly cohesive clusters of ductal cells on FNAC

shortlist.label: tubular carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: well-defined lesion in right breast on MRI

raw.rationale: The presence of a hard, fixed lump in the left breast, MRI findings of an irregular spiculated mass, and fine-needle aspiration cytology showing poorly cohesive clusters of ductal cells with pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, and prominent nucleoli, along with core-needle biopsy confirmation of infiltrative duct cell carcinoma, strongly support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: inflammatory breast cancer
rejected.why: There is no mention of characteristic symptoms such as diffuse erythema, edema, or warmth of the breast skin.

rejected.label: lobular carcinoma
rejected.why: The biopsy and cytology results do not specifically indicate a lobular origin of the cancer.

rejected.label: phyllodes tumor
rejected.why: The description and diagnostic findings do not match the typical characteristics of a phyllodes tumor, which often presents as a large, rapidly growing mass.

rejected.label: fibroadenoma
rejected.why: While the right breast lump was suspected to be a fibroadenoma based on its firm and mobile nature, the left breast lump's characteristics and diagnostic findings are not consistent with fibroadenoma.

rejected.label: metastatic disease to the breast
rejected.why: There is no evidence provided that the breast cancer is metastatic from another primary site.

rejected.label: medullary carcinoma
rejected.why: The diagnostic findings do not specifically indicate the characteristic features of medullary carcinoma, such as a well-circumscribed mass with a syncytial growth pattern and high-grade nuclei.

rejected.label: tubular carcinoma
rejected.why: The biopsy and cytology results do not specifically indicate the characteristic tubular structures of tubular carcinoma.
